One page for all the art: seven sections down the page, To Do first, every picture numbered and straight out of the game, with Al's and Laura's marks. How it works The page opens on what is Finished: everything either of you has ticked Finished, from every section, the newest first, with LAURA, AL or LAURA + AL for whose; and on the filter bar, Show: NEW | OLD turns every finished piece on the page to its new drawing or its old one. Then come the characters, then the treasures, then Sarge's gear (his rack and his irons), the buttons and menus, the gameplay and the screens, one section after another, every picture straight out of the game. The buttons at the top jump to each section; the one you are in is lit. Ticks for Al and Laura: tap Working on it on anything when you start on it, and Finished when you are happy with its final art. You both see the same marks, each with who set it and when; they refresh by themselves every 20 seconds. Tap your own lit mark again to take it off. A mark the other person set asks first before it becomes yours. Pick your name at the top once on each device. The counts and the filters at the top are the whole page's: Working shows everything either of you is working on, in every section, and a section with nothing under the filter folds away. The number on each section's button is what it shows under the filter. Every picture has a number that never changes: the characters 001 on, then V for the villages, BG for the background characters, T for the treasures, SG for Sarge's gear, B for the buttons and menus, G for the gameplay and S for the screens.

Characters

243 characters, 429 drawings (every pose each one has in the game), straight out of the game, version 31.58. Each one is a 2048 by 2048 JPEG on white. At the end of the page: the villages, 43 Shape Store works, each with the file the Shape Store opens. After them, the background characters (76), each with its JPEG and its layers (jump to them). The treasures have their own section further down.

Shaded like Sarge's hats. 337 drawings here wear the hats' shading (Al's ask, October 11): each coloured piece keeps its colour and its outline, with a lighter edge of the same colour on its upper left and a darker band low on its right. Your own drawings and the army men wear it too; Jane stays as you drew her. The outer outlines are thinner and every line takes its own piece's colour, a step darker, the way Bluey is drawn (Al's rule, October 11): a pale piece gets a soft line, a dark piece a nearly black one, a line over another piece keeps its own colour, and a smile or a toe line takes the colour of the piece it sits on. Every line is even and a little heavier than Bluey's (Al's pick of three), and a character drawn without an outline gets one the same way (Al, October 13). The army men wear it too, with a heavier, darker line of their own and lighter shading kept to the edges that face the background, so each man reads as one form (Al, October 13). Every new character gets it the moment it appears here, and the game draws them the same way (since October 15, Al's ask).

This page keeps itself up to date. When a new version of the game goes live, every drawing here is redrawn from it, usually within half an hour (now: version 31.58, November 12 at 12:58 AM Eastern). Numbers never change; a new character gets the next free number and says NEW IN and the version (the Masters' stages' animals are at the end, one group per continent). A drawing that changed since the first list says UPDATED IN and the version. 338 drawings say so now.

Layers for Procreate: tap LAYERS (PSD) under a drawing. Your browser builds a layered Photoshop file of it (every coloured piece its own layer, named for the part it belongs to, 48 layers at most). On an iPad or an iPhone the share sheet opens with the file: pick Procreate and it opens there with its layers (or Save to Files). If the button says READY, tap it once more. Anywhere else it saves to Downloads (in Procreate: Gallery, Import). The number on the button is its layer count.
Just one picture? Tap it. On an iPad or an iPhone the share sheet opens with the full JPEG: pick Procreate, Save Image or Save to Files (a Finished piece opens its NOW | BEFORE view first: Save this JPEG there). Anywhere else it saves to Downloads. If nothing opens, open this page in Safari (the compass button at the bottom of the in-app browser) and tap again. A letter after the number (001-a, 001-b) is the same character in another pose.
The villages: every house, shop, prop and animal at the end of this page is a Shape Store work. Tap SHAPE STORE FILE under one to save its file, then on the Shape Store's desk (drbango.com/shapestore) tap GALLERY, then IMPORT A .JSON WORK, and pick it: every piece is yours to move or recolour. Tap its picture for the JPEG.

Sarge's Gear

Everything Sarge can wear or carry, 309 pictures straight out of version 31.58: the rack of his quarters rail by rail, helmets and hats first, then the face, body armor, over the armor, legs and boots, then the weapons rail. Each tile is the rack's own picture of the piece, a 2048 by 2048 JPEG on white, named as the rack names it. A piece that is won in play is here too, though the rack hides it until it is yours. This section keeps itself up to date: when a new version of the game goes live, every picture here is taken again; one that changed says UPDATED IN and the version, a new one NEW IN. Numbers never change.

HELMETS AND HATS

The head rail of Sarge's rack: every helmet and hat as the rack's own tile draws it, in the rack's order. One on his head at a time. Then Wyatt's 17 picks for the rack, drawn in the gear gallery and not in the game yet: each tile says Wyatt's pick · new.

FACE

The face rail: moustaches, masks, glasses and the pieces that ride an eye.

OVER THE ARMOR

Over the armor: the belts, the poncho, the badge, the sash, the pads, the corsage and the plate carrier.

GLOVES

The gloves rail: every pair of gloves.

LEGS

The legs rail: every pair of pants and greaves. Then Wyatt's pick for the rack, drawn in the gear gallery and not in the game yet: its tile says Wyatt's pick · new.

BOOTS

The boots rail: every pair of boots, shoes and spurs.

SOCKS

The socks rail.

ON HIS BACK

The capes, wings and what he carries on his back. The rack has no back rail yet, so these stand here for now. Then Wyatt's 5 picks for the rack, drawn in the gear gallery and not in the game yet: each tile says Wyatt's pick · new.

THE IRONS

The WEAPONS rail of the quarters: each iron alone, as the rail draws it; the faces an iron takes as it grows stand beside it (the twin pistols; the Claymore, the High Blade, the Flame Blade and the Ice Blade are the Commander's).

Every part Floop builds or a player wins, as the lab's own card draws it, in the lab's order. These fit the army and Sarge's irons rather than the rack, so they stand after the irons.
